summary: Shallow resource teardown structurally parallel to MultiFieldPointerFree (00414380). Resets the text-format struct via TextFormatStructInitializer_4fe0, runs two two-iteration countdown loops freeing four 5-dword-strided pointer slots below the anchors this+23 and this+13, each freed when non-null through FreeWrapper_7bcf, then frees the main pointer at this+0. When flag bit a2 bit 0 is set, the object itself is freed after its fields. Returns this. Invoked by SceneListBuilderFromGlobalArray (00415C40).

local_names.a2: teardown flag; bit 0 requests the object itself be freed

operations.description: Reset the text-format struct by calling TextFormatStructInitializer_4fe0 on this before pointer-field teardown.
Two-iteration countdown loop from anchor this+23: each iteration loads the slot 5 dwords below the current anchor, frees it via FreeWrapper_7bcf when non-null, and steps the anchor down by 5.
Two-iteration countdown loop from anchor this+13: frees the two 5-dword-strided pointer slots below it when non-null.
Guard on the main pointer field at this+0: it is freed only when non-null.
Free the main pointer field at this+0 via FreeWrapper_7bcf when the guard passes.
Guard on a2 bit 0: when set, the object pointer itself is freed after its fields.
Free the this object itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf when a2 bit 0 is set.
Return this, so callers can chain or observe the (possibly freed) pointer.
Invoked by SceneListBuilderFromGlobalArray (00415C40) as the teardown for the scene-list objects it builds.

clean_pseudocode: do { q = *(p - 5); p -= 5; if (q) FreeWrapper_7bcf(q); } while (--n);
